storage_planes.name: human_memory
storage_planes.portability: high for SQLite export/import; medium semantic portability due to JSON metadata conventions
storage_planes.migration_friendliness: good for card/evidence/event export; requires typed decoders for context_json

storage_planes.name: legacy_v0_cardex
storage_planes.portability: medium; schema is explicit but semantics are split across v0 memory and Cardex
graph_limitations: card_refs are typed refs not a general graph
storage_planes.migration_friendliness: mixed; rich multimodal structures are valuable but need projection into one v2 model

storage_planes.name: telemetry_jsonl
storage_planes.migration_friendliness: useful as evidence/observability input, not durable memory source of truth

storage_planes.name: mimir_local_artifacts
storage_planes.portability: out of scope for Muninn v2 migration
storage_planes.note: present in repository working tree but belongs to Mimir tooling, not Muninn storage

sqlite_suitability.assessment: SQLite remains suitable for local-first Muninn v2 if the substrate contract is explicit and export/import is first-class.
strengths: works for local agents and development
risks: large multimodal assets should not live directly in core tables
graph traversal and salience propagation may outgrow simple relational queries
schema evolution needs formal migrations rather than self-healing patches only

jsonl_compatibility.assessment: Good for event streams, telemetry, migration manifests, and export ledgers; insufficient alone for queryable substrate state.

future_proofing_gaps: No general association table shared by all memory types.
No recall history table in human-memory.
No first-class entity table in human-memory.
Multimodal assets are in Cardex, not unified with active human-memory.
recommended_storage_direction: Keep SQLite as the first v2 backend, but design v2 around stable contracts and explicit export/import manifests so other backends can be added later.
